settings.propertyDescription: The API root of the Sysdig Secure instance.
The Sysdig Secure API token.

The server Address of the Tenable Security Center.
The username of the Tenable Security Center account. Note: Both “Username” and “Password” must be provided.
The password of the Tenable Security Center account. Note: Both “Username” and “Password” must be provided.
The Access Key of the Tenable Security Center account. Note: Both “Access Key” and “Secret Key” must be provided.
The Secret Key of the Tenable Security Center account. Note: Both “Access Key” and “Secret Key” must be provided.

API Root of the Vertex AI integration.

The client email address of your workload identity. You can configure either this parameter or the Service Account Json File Content parameter. To impersonate service accounts with the workload identity email address, grant the Service Account Token Creator role to your service account.

The content of the service account key JSON file. You can configure either this parameter or the Workload Identity Email parameter. To configure this parameter, provide the full content of the service account key JSON file that you downloaded when creating a service account.
The project ID to use in the integration. If you don't set a value for this parameter, the integration retrieves the project ID from your Google Cloud service account.
The location ID to use in generative API calls.
The name of the default model to use in the integration.
The name of the default publisher for the model.
If selected, the integration verifies that the SSL certificate for connecting to Vertex AI is valid. Selected by default.

API Root of the Web Risk integration.

The client email address of your workload identity. You can configure either this parameter or the Service Account Json File Content parameter. To impersonate service accounts with the workload identity email address, grant the Service Account Token Creator role to your service account.

The content of the service account key JSON file. You can configure either this parameter or the Workload Identity Email parameter. To configure this parameter, provide the full content of the service account key JSON file that you downloaded when creating a service account.

The Google Cloud project ID which you use for Google Cloud APIs and billing. This parameter requires you to grant the Service Usage Consumer role to your service account.
The integration attaches this parameter value to all API requests. If you don't set a value for this parameter, the integration retrieves the quota project ID from your Google Cloud service account.
The project ID to use in the integration. If you don't set a value for this parameter, the integration retrieves the project ID from your Google Cloud service account.
If selected, the integration verifies that the SSL certificate for connecting to Vertex AI is valid. Selected by default.
The base URL of the Zscaler instance.

The username or email address associated with the Zscaler administrator account used for authentication. This parameter is mandatory for legacy authentication. If both legacy and OAuth 2.0 credentials are provided, OAuth 2.0 takes precedence.

The unique API key generated in the Zscaler portal to authorize API requests. This parameter is mandatory for legacy authentication. If both legacy and OAuth 2.0 credentials are provided, OAuth 2.0 takes precedence.

The password associated with the Zscaler administrator account used for authentication. This parameter is mandatory for legacy authentication. If both legacy and OAuth 2.0 credentials are provided, OAuth 2.0 takes precedence.

The unique identifier for the OAuth 2.0 client used for authentication using the ZSLogin service. This parameter is mandatory for OAuth 2.0 configuration and takes precedence over legacy authentication.
The secret key associated with the client ID used to authenticate the OAuth 2.0 client. This parameter is mandatory for OAuth 2.0 configuration and takes precedence over legacy authentication.
The base URL for the ZSLogin service used for centralized identity and access management. This parameter is mandatory for OAuth 2.0 configuration and takes precedence over legacy authentication.
If selected, the integration validates the SSL certificate when connecting to the Zscaler server.
The API root of the Zerofox instance.
The Zerofox API token.
If selected, the integration validates the SSL certificate when connecting to Zerofox. Selected by default.
